g.text: TODO: remove the admin password before launch
fix: Deny access to VCS folders in the server config, remove them from the web root,
and rotate any secrets in the history.
fix: Remove the file from the web root and block the path in the server config; rotate
fix: Disable directory listing (Apache: `Options -Indexes`; nginx: `autoindex off`).
fix: Validate Origin against an allow-list; never reflect it, especially with
Possible secret in client-side code: AWS access key
fix: Remove it from public code, rotate it, and call the third-party API from your
fix: Add a Content-Security-Policy, e.g. `default-src 'self'`, and loosen only as
fix: Disable it (Apache: `TraceEnable off`; nginx rejects it by default).
fix: Set HttpOnly so scripts cannot read the cookie (PHP: `session.cookie_httponly=1`).
fix: Do not deploy .map files to production, or restrict them to developers.
fix: Upgrade jQuery to 3.5.0 or newer.
fix: Hide the version (Apache: `ServerTokens Prod`; nginx: `server_tokens off`).
Path listed in robots.txt is publicly reachable
fix: robots.txt is not access control. Require authentication for private areas.
fix: Allow only the methods each route needs.
fix: Set SameSite=Lax (or Strict) to reduce CSRF risk.
fix: Add `integrity="sha384-..." crossorigin="anonymous"` to third-party scripts.
fix: Strip comments from production HTML (build step or template engine).
